The file tables

What the catalog knows about files

TableWhat it holds
ducklake_data_filepath, row count and size of each data file
ducklake_delete_filedelete files and the data file they belong to
ducklake_file_column_statsmin and max per column per file
ducklake_file_partition_valuethe partition each file belongs to
ducklake_table_statstotals per table
ducklake_inlined_data_tablestables of inlined rows
